note: Private campground & cabins (25 sites) near Bradford (McKean Co), within/near the Allegheny National Forest on Route 59. All full-hookup, 6 pull-thrus, pool, heated bath house. The operator says the park and cabins are open all year. Boat launches/beach ~8 mi away (not on-site). --Claude
